To determine the relationship between research competence and undergraduate teaching performance at a public university in Iquitos, Peru. Methodology. A quantitative, non-experimental, cross-sectional, and correlational study was conducted. The population comprised 570 undergraduate faculty members, from whom a non-probability sample of 80 was selected. Using a survey method, two Likert-scale questionnaires were administered: a 39-item research competence questionnaire (Balbo et al., 2015) and a 30-item teaching performance questionnaire (Pimienta Prieto, 2014). Content validity was established through review by a panel of five experts, and reliability was estimated using Cronbach’s alpha (α = .896 and α = .970, respectively). Associations were examined using Spearman’s rho. Findings. Environmental education in Chile has been integrated into formal education through initiatives such as the 2019 curricular innovation, where curricular contextualization allows for the inclusion of instructional guides. In the Maule Region, a project was proposed to develop a biodiversity guide centered on the Magellanic woodpecker (Campephilus magellanicus); this species is endemic to Chile and Argentina, faces conservation challenges, and is considered an "umbrella species." Objective. To evaluate changes in students' biodiversity knowledge resulting from the use of an instructional guide focused on the Magellanic woodpecker. Methodology. A quasi-experimental quantitative study was conducted involving an instructional intervention. text_snippet: Comprensión lectora en estudiantado universitario de primer año: Hallazgos del estudio DIALECT en Costa Rica Reading Comprehension in First-Year University Students: Insights From the DIALECT Study in Costa Rica Compreensão de leitura em estudantes universitários do primeiro ano: Percepções do estudo DIALECT na Costa Rica Objective. Reading comprehension skills are key in higher education for acquiring complex knowledge. This study explores these skills and their predictive factors among first-year university students and identifies gaps between the texts used in first-year courses and students’ reading comprehension levels. Methodology. A total of 689 first-year university students (age: m = 19.27 years; SD = 3.30) were assessed using DIALECT, an adaptive digital test designed to diagnose reading comprehension skills. A Rasch model analysis was conducted to explore the reliability and technical quality of DIALECT. A descriptive analysis was carried out to characterize the sample, along with group comparisons using non-parametric tests when appropriate. A multiple regression model was used to assess the relationship between predictor variables and test scores. Findings. At the Main Campus, only 14% reached a satisfactory level, compared to 6.3% at the Regional Campuses. This article presents some of the findings from the international project “University Faculty Identity and the Pedagogy of Otherness,” which explores the identity formation of university faculty members with more than twenty-five years of experience. Objective. The study aimed to identify and interpret the personal, contextual, and ethical elements that, from the perspective of the pedagogy of otherness, define the identity of university faculty, specifically in Colombia at a public university in the city of Manizales. Methodology. The research was approached from the perspective of complementarity (Murcia Peña & Jaramillo Echeverri, 2008), a holistic perspective that made it possible to listen to, perceive, and engage with a social reality in order to understand it. This research was conducted to understand perceptions of the use of social media for collaborative learning among university students at a higher education institution in southern Sonora, Mexico. This article presents an exploratory quantitative study carried out in an integrated vocational training centre located in Andalusia. The sample consists of 185 intermediate and higher-levels students from seven professional families. Objectives. The study aims to analyze the level of attitude towards entrepreneurship and the impact of the Entrepreneurship Classroom (ADE) on vocational training students. Methodology. The study employs a quantitative, exploratory, and cross-sectional approach. Validated instruments, specifically the ATE-S test and the Personal Initiative Questionnaire, were used. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, Pearson correlations, K-means cluster analysis, and inferential tests (ANOVA and multiple linear regression) with SPSS software. Results. The results show a moderate entrepreneurial potential in the student body, with differences associated mainly with age and participation in specific programmes such as the Entrepreneurship Classroom. This study aims to analyze the opinions and assessments of young people and educational professionals from the Colegio Misioneras school community, located in La Palma-Palmilla (Málaga, Spain), a territory affected by processes of social exclusion, regarding the circumstances they face and the role of the school and the Bajar a la calle project as spaces for support, participation, and socio-educational accompaniment. Methodology. A qualitative case study oriented toward critical reflection was conducted with 61 participants: young people aged 14 to 20 and educational professionals. Data were generated through seven individual interviews, four focus groups, and four thematic podcasts. The material was transcribed and subjected to inductive coding with the support of ATLAS.ti, comparing data across the different techniques and participant profiles. Results. The findings reveal an experience of the neighborhood marked by mixed feelings: alongside difficulties and social stigma, participants also express a sense of belonging and mutual support. Stereotypes reinforce gender gaps, influence the development of identities, and affect educational aspirations of teenage girls. Objective. Due to scarce research on gender and education at pre-university levels in Costa Rica, this mixed study with a convergent-parallel design seeks to understand persistent stereotypes in the Brunca Region on becoming a professional woman in STEM careers. Methodology. The quantitative phase employed a cross-sectional design using two randomized surveys of 56 women in STEM careers and 43 teenagers soon to finish their high school education in the region. The qualitative phase included 6 focus groups with high schoolers, 7 interviews with their guidance counselors, and 7 with STEM teachers. To carry out the data analysis, the quantitative and qualitative data were processed independently to identify categories, themes, and statistics. The data was later combined to facilitate the interpretation of convergences and divergences. The study employed a qualitative exploratory-descriptive design. The sample consisted of 11 preservice mathematics teachers. Data were collected through self-learning modules implemented during the professional practicum, with rubrics used as assessment instruments. The preservice teachers demonstrated competencies in the fundamentals and applications of artificial intelligence. title: La microenseñanza en la formación inicial docente: Una revisión sistemática Microteaching in Initial Teacher Education: A Systematic Review O microensino na formação inicial de professores: Uma revisão sistemática
text_snippet: La microenseñanza en la formación inicial docente: Una revisión sistemática Microteaching in Initial Teacher Education: A Systematic Review O microensino na formação inicial de professores: Uma revisão sistemática Introduction. Microteaching (MT) aims to reduce gaps in Initial Teacher Education (ITE) by bringing prospective teachers closer to the realities of educational practice. The diverse ways in which MT is applied raise the need to understand the different emphases and modalities of implementation. Objective. To analyze empirical research on microteaching in ITE published between 2020 and 2024, focusing on its educational purposes and implementation dynamics. Methodology. A systematic review was conducted using the PRISMA (2020) protocol in two stages: document identification and screening (September 2024–January 2025) and thematic analysis. Searches of Web of Science and Scopus used the terms “microteaching” and “pre-service teacher” and included peer-reviewed empirical articles on ITE published in Spanish or English from 2020 to 2024. Of the 24 records initially identified, 1 duplicate was removed and 3 articles were removed because they addressed continuing education or teacher professional development; a final sample of 20 articles was obtained. title: Implementación del método funcional para el abordaje de trastornos del lenguaje: Aportes y tensiones desde una perspectiva inclusiva Implementation of the Functional Method for Addressing Language Disorders: Contributions and Tensions from an Inclusive Perspective Implementação do Método Funcional no Enfrentamento dos Transtornos de Linguagem: Contribuições e Tensões a partir de uma Perspectiva Inclusiva

This study analyzes the implementation of the functional method as a pedagogical strategy in special language schools and examines its effectiveness in the development of linguistic skills in children with language disorders. The approach is based on the use of language in meaningful and natural contexts adapted to individual needs. In doing so, it overcomes the limitations of traditional methods and promotes enriching social interactions. At the same time, it remains in tension with current challenges of inclusive education. Objective. To determine how the functional method contributes to the linguistic and social development of students with language disorders, considering the factors that influence its sustained implementation in specialized contexts. title: Análisis de la proporción de aprobación en colegios de Costa Rica por rama de estudio en el periodo 2014-2019 Analysis of the Approval Rate in Costa Rican High Schools by Field of Study in the Period 2014-2019 Análise da taxa de aprovação em colégios da Costa Rica por área de estudo no período de 2014-2019

This study analyzes whether there are significant differences in the approval rating between these two educational options (technical and academic), overall, and by gender, during the period of 2014-2019. Method. Official data from the Ministry of Public Education (MEP) was used based on select, public high schools with information available for at least five of the six years of the period analyzed. The sample included 311 academic high schools (259 daytime and 52 night) and 167 technical high schools (124 daytime and 43 night). Three response variables were defined: overall approval rating, female and male approval rating. Generalized linear mixed models (GLMM) with a beta distribution were fitted, including random effects for school and interaction terms between modality and time. The significance of the effects was evaluated using likelihood ratio tests. Conclusions. title: Del conflicto a la conciencia: Una pedagogía para la autorregulación emocional en la educación secundaria From Conflict to Consciousness: A Pedagogy for Emotional Self-Regulation in Secondary Education Do conflito à consciência: Uma pedagogia para a autorregulação emocional na educação secundária

In the classroom, it is recognized that not everything can be explained by rules. This paper addresses emotional self-regulation with a forceful statement: without emotional self-regulation, the school becomes underperforming. It is demonstrated by everyday experience that when there is no space to express what you feel, everything becomes more tense and colder and learning doesn’t occur in the same manner. Purpose. The purpose of this essay is to argue, based on a review of literature on metacognition, self-regulation, and emotional education, why emotional self-regulation should be understood as a baseline condition for school coexistence and learning, rather than a secondary matter relative to the academic curriculum. To this end, the essay collects multiple voices, ideas, and experiences that overlap in the same call: another manner of being at school is needed. The one that does not overlook anger, sadness, or rage, but embraces and comprehends them, because the starting point resides in the emotional issue, which is not an ornament. Discussion. title: Características psicológicas del personal docente universitario: Desde la percepción del estudiantado Psychological Characteristics of University Teaching Staff: From the Students’ Perspective Características Psicológicas do Corpo Docente Universitário: Na Perspectiva dos Estudantes

The study aims to present students’ perceptions of certain psychological characteristics of university teaching staff and to compare them with the staff’s own self-perceptions. Method. A quantitative approach with a descriptive-comparative design was used. A survey was administered to a sample of 452 people, including both professors and students, to collect data on these characteristics. The survey had a Cronbach’s alpha reliability of 0.886. Conclusions. The study concludes that there are differences in perception regarding characteristics such as vocation, democratic, selfless, honest, fair, objective, participative, paternalistic, proactive, self-critical, punctual, enthusiastic, facilitative, and providing feedback. However, students agree on characteristics such as creating a climate of trust, good character, humaneness, respect, and empathy. This indicates that students generally perceive university professors as good.

title: The Concept of Educational Equity in Educational Research: A Scoping Review El concepto de equidad educativa en la investigación educativa: Una revisión de alcance O conceito de equidade educacional na pesquisa em educação: Uma revisão de escopo
text_snippet: The Concept of Educational Equity in Educational Research: A Scoping Review El concepto de equidad educativa en la investigación educativa: Una revisión de alcance O conceito de equidade educacional na pesquisa em educação: Uma revisão de escopo Introduction. Educational equity is a core principle of democratic education systems. However, its conceptual definition remains contested in scientific research, limiting its analytical clarity and practical application. The term is frequently associated with equality, justice, or educational quality, giving rise to persistent conceptual tensions. Objective. This study aims to analyze how educational equity is conceptually characterized in international research and to identify its defining features and relationships with other key educational concepts. Analysis. A scoping review was conducted following the PCC framework, the PRISMA-ScR protocol, the PRISMA 2020 diagram, and the SALSA framework. Articles published between 2013 and 2022 were retrieved from Web of Science, Scopus, and ERIC. Fifty-three empirical studies explicitly defining educational equity were analyzed using qualitative coding supported by grounded theory principles. Results. In education, comparing national curricula is a powerful strategy for improving educational quality. Objective. This study provides a comprehensive analysis of the education systems of Indonesia and Finland to identify factors that contribute to the performance gap, notably in secondary education. Methodology. This study employed library research involving an in-depth review and analysis of legal documents obtained from official institutions, libraries, specialized legal websites, and Ministry of Education archives. This article presents a systematic account of an educational research experience implemented in sections 001 and 002 of the course ED0039: Fundamentals of Educational Administration, taught by two faculty members in the Department of Education at the Western Campus of the University of Costa Rica in 2024. Objective. The study aimed to determine how students in initial teacher education perceive the importance of developing creativity and innovation to construct educational proposals as fundamental competencies for exercising pedagogical leadership in response to twenty-first-century educational demands. Methodology. The study adopted a qualitative approach with a descriptive and interpretive scope. A total of 64 students, organized into 16 subgroups, participated in the study, designing educational entrepreneurship projects using a structured guide for project design and reflection. Analysis. Emotional regulation has become a central focus in education due to its close relationship with student well-being, school climate, and learning processes, particularly in a context of increasing demand for socio-emotional support in schools. Purpose. This essay aims to propose a functional and operational classification of the main theoretical models of emotional regulation, oriented toward their applicability in educational contexts. Discussion. Drawing on a critical analysis of the main theoretical models of emotional regulation, four core approaches are identified and examined: relational, cognitive-metacognitive, socio-emotional competency-based, and clinical-applied. Their conceptual foundations, tensions, and convergences are analyzed, along with shared principles that support an integrated understanding. In addition, the need to move beyond a linear translation from theory to practice is emphasized, acknowledging that the pedagogical implementation of these models is context-sensitive and grounded in reflective practice. Análise crítica do relatório da OCDE sobre educação na Costa Rica Introduction. This article presents a critical analysis of the report: OECD Economic Surveys: Costa Rica 2023 (OECD, 2023b). Purpose. Critically review this report, understanding the vision of education that is proposed and its implications. Discussion. The report is analyzed, in terms of its vision of education, the educational system, and national development. Initially, the report is put into context, after which the observations of this document on the Costa Rican education system are presented and discussed, making a critical assessment of them. Conclusions. The OECD report for Costa Rica focuses on the relationship between education, employment, and the economy, losing sight of other key variables in the development of people and societies.

The objective of this research is to determine if the underlying factors of intention influence the use of tablets in Higher Education students, using the theory of planned behavior. Methodology. The research carried out was quantitative in nature, with a non-experimental cross-sectional cohort design. A convenience survey was applied to 330 students from an Engineering Faculty in northern Chile. The data obtained were tabulated, considering the attitude variables, subjective norms, perceived behavioral control and intention to use. The statistical procedure was carried out, considering the exploratory and confirmatory factor analysis and the structural equation, using the JASP software. Results. The main finding found allows us to interpret that attitude and perceived behavioral control present a positive relationship with the intention to use, while the subjective norm results in a negative and non-significant relationship with the intention to use tablets.
